annotations.title: Scan Playlists After a Distributor Warning

description: Scores every Spotify playlist an artist pastes after a distributor flags a track for artificial streaming (the full list from Spotify for Artists). Use it for a batch of up to 50 links; for one playlist, use check_playlist. Returns each playlist ranked by bot-risk score with skip reasons for invalid or unavailable links. Limits: 1 scan per visitor per day, with no sign-in, and the full ranked report every time. Errors: INVALID_PARAMS (no playlist links found), RATE_LIMITED (daily scan used).

links.description: Spotify playlist links, URIs or ids, one per line (also accepts comma or space separated), as pasted from Spotify for Artists. Up to 50.

name: scan_warning_playlists
